headline: Russian Strike Damaged Energy Grid and Infrastructure in Ukraine's Chornomorsk
summary: An overnight Russian strike on the Black Sea port city of Chornomorsk injured six people and damaged energy infrastructure. The attack also ruptured a gas pipeline and damaged administrative and residential buildings.
why: Black Sea ports handle key agricultural and industrial shipments for Ukraine, while energy grid strikes harm domestic industrial output.

impacts.name: Ukraine
impacts.why: Damage to energy and port infrastructure reduces local economic activity and export potential.
